graph_discipline: Roots remain nodes; branches are edge or port labels, not graph nodes.

root_resolution.note: The basmala is included in the analysis frame. It reinforces divine lordship, mercy, welcome, and beneficence without adding roots to the supplied branch inventory. Furūq-only branches remain valid even when absent from the selected Qnet theme layer.

surface_mechanism: 89:28 commands the tranquil soul to return to its Lord while both pleased and approved, activating return, ultimate return to God, lordship, and reciprocal satisfaction.
89:29 turns return into social incorporation: the soul is commanded to enter among God's servants.
89:30 repeats the entry command and names the destination as God's afterlife garden.
The repeated second-person feminine imperatives and first-person possessives form a movement from divine summons, through belonging, into protected eschatological dwelling.
